title: Range Capital Acquisition Corp. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-20
summary: Range Capital Acquisition Corp., a Cayman Islands SPAC listed on Nasdaq (tickers RANGU/RANG/RANGR), issued an unsecured promissory note for up to $1,500,000 to Range Capital Holdings LLC, an affiliate of the sponsor. The note is non-interest-bearing and matures upon consummation of an initial business combination, with conversion rights into Working Capital Units at $10.00 per unit.
